in_arabic.name: اورعاء
in_arabic.meaning: أصل الاسم من العروص و هو العرض و العرضة و العود
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإسم أورعاء من العروص و هو العرض و العرضة و العود و هو اسم فاضل بمعنى الطيب و النافع و العريض و الباع و الإعراض عن الشؤون الدنيوية و التفرغ للعلم و التأمل و العود إلى الله تعالى

in_urdu.name: اورعاء
in_urdu.meaning: اسم کا اصل عروص ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چھپنا نہ کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اورعاء نام کی اصل عروص ہے جو کہ چھپنا نہ کرنا کے معنی میں ہے، یہ نام فاضل ہے اور اس کے معنی طيب، نافع، عريض، باع، اعراض ہیں، یہ نام علم و تامل اور الله تعالى کے قرب میں لے جانے کے معنی میں ہے

in_hindi.name: ऊरवाः
in_hindi.meaning: अर्थ यह है कि सार्वजनिक तौर पर दिखना
in_hindi.long_meaning: ऊरवाः नाम का अर्थ है सार्वजनिक तौर पर दिखना, यह नाम एक प्रतिष्ठित नाम है जिसके अर्थ हैं सुंदर, लाभदायक, व्यापक, निपुण और भगवान से विनम्र

in_pashto.name: اورعاء
in_pashto.meaning: اورعاء دا اصل عروص دېدی چې په عربي کې د دې معنا څرګندوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: اورعاء دا نوم د عروص څخه اخیستل شوی چې په اصل کې د عروض، عرضه اوعود معنا لري، دا نوم په افغانستان کې د عراض، اعراض اوعرض کې د معنویت ساتونکي نوم په توګه کارول کېږي

in_english.name: Urwaa
in_english.meaning: A name that means being open and transparent to the public
in_english.long_meaning: The name Urwaa is derived from the Arabic root 'ur-aa', which means being open or transparent to the public, and to return to God. It is a name of excellence and nobility, signifying one who is pious, beneficial, and wide-ranging in their character and actions. It is a name that reflects the qualities of one who is devoted to spiritual pursuits and is not distracted by worldly matters.

data.cultural_impact: The name Urwaa holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic word for "lion," an animal that has been respected for its strength and courage in various civilizations, including the Islamic world. For Muslims, the lion represents valor and fearlessness. In the novels depicted in Urwaa al-Wakidani ("The Pearl of the Arabs," a classic Arabic literature masterpiece), Urwaa is portrayed as a noble hero who demonstrates the virtues of courage and self-sacrifice. Thus, the name resembles the valor and strength of the Islamic heroes of the past.
data.spiritual_significance: Urwaa is not merely a name derived from a lion, but it signifies the spiritual qualities that a Muslim should aspire to in their daily lives. The lion's courage and fearlessness echo the courage and resilience that a Muslim must cultivate in their hearts to face life's challenges. When someone is named Urwaa, it serves as a daily reminder for them to embody this courageous spirit. In Islamic texts, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is described as a courageous leader, showing how the quality of courage is highly valued and required in a believer. Thus, Urwaa as a name carries the essence of the Islamic values of courage, strength, and resilience, urging its bearer to exemplify those virtues in their thoughts, words, and actions.
